main_text.l: Culmina Werdena fluvii sic nomine dicta,
Et valido validas ponte coarctat aquas.
Angulus hac Rura nomina ferre potest.
Rura gravi tandem motu defessus aquarum,
Cum famulis Rheni sceptra subintrat aquis.
main_text.p: Idem Mollerus de Lena, Bicha, Hennæpa, Volma, Mona, & Veistera fluviis Ruram ingredientibus, ita canit.
main_text.head: Descriptio Fluviorum Ruram ingredientium.
main_text.p: Lena capit Bicha fluctus, pravelsa Siburgi, Castra Sicambrorum laude notata rigat.
main_text.l: Lena, sed amisso protinus amne perit.
Qua relevat parvo sedeis Hustena nitore,
Rura subit Rura flumen amicus init.
Qui simul ac nomen Volmena praestitit arcis,
Perditur in Rura viscera mersus abit.
Rura statim Monas flumen adesse videt.
Est calidus, pleno dum Carula frigore constant,
Dum gelido tellus marmore stricta riget.
Necprius ac Rura datur, frigescit in isto
Candida per plures despectant ostia vici
Culumina pro multis dicere pauca libet.

page.notes: The large initial L is joined to "Lena". Some lines of verse are set at an indent and are read as printed. Doubtful readings: "Vaisters"/"Veistera" and the printed forms of several river names are copied as they appear. The left margin has a faint mark near the foot that is not text.
